# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Runtime and WebGPU improvements**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves managed rendering performance and makes WebGPU browser applications easier to build. Image pixel transfers and HarfBuzz text handling now avoid avoidable allocations, while Android continuous texture rendering follows the display refresh rate.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Android texture rendering follows the display clock** — Automatic continuous frames for Android GL texture views are paced by display refresh callbacks, avoiding redraws driven by buffer-swap throughput while preserving explicit render requests. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Front-buffered managed streams release their backing data** — Front-buffered managed streams no longer retain their initial data after it is no longer needed. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Image copying and text shaping allocate less** — Managed pixel copies can take a direct raster path, and HarfBuzz text and feature conversion reuse stack or pooled storage to reduce allocation overhead without changing decoded values. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **WebGPU browser builds package native C++ support** — The WebGPU C++ port is now built into libSkiaSharp.a, so browser applications no longer compile it during their final link while retaining the required JavaScript glue. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
